_note: Copy of six_scenarios_v80.json for the v63 '_r3' campaign. Identical selection/CT settings; the only additions are the per-scenario 'pdf_path' keys and the updated labels. 'pdf_path' overrides the run-wide PDF_PATH for that scenario alone (see test/run_small_sample_pipeline.sh catalog-extras block and python/ana/scenario_cos_theta_report.py); a catalog without the key behaves exactly as before. Scenario 3 (full pipeline) uses the global CC-mixture/flat-CC table, every other scenario uses ED v63's own table. Scenario 4 is insensitive to the table and is given v63's own table for consistency. Scenario 1 uses true directions (ED disabled) so its table only sets the energy-dependent kappa.
